name: Joss Var
lore: A former convoy assessor who survived a purge by carrying the erased debts of an entire route network in a cipher ledger.

abilities.name: Ledger Broker
abilities.text: Once per session, when you accept your first Contract, set its progress to at least 1.

abilities.name: Silent Audit
abilities.text: Once per round, after you clear a sector with no unresolved blockers, gain +1 Guile on your next Guile check this turn.

abilities.name: Debt Knife
abilities.text: Once per round, after you defeat an enemy while you have an active Contract, advance that Contract by 1 valid progress step.

abilities.name: Black File
abilities.text: Once per round, after you complete a Contract, record a private leverage entry and reduce scenario pressure by 1 if it is above 0.
